_comment: SINGLE SOURCE for hardware-name → FastenerKind. A fastener GROUP's leading word (before the article number) declares its function — name hardware intentionally and everything downstream derives. Referred to by core/assembly/liaisons.ts (runtime fastenerKindOf) and helper-scripts/read-parts.mjs + extract-structure.mjs (fastener detection). First matching prefix wins; a group matching NO prefix is still a fastener if its mesh name joins two parts (…__a&b) and then defaults to 'secured' (never preload). kinds: secured = fastens part(s) onto an existing joint (screw/nail/cap/nut/washer/rivet — no OR-side insert, no preload); threaded = defines a screw joint whose counterpart SCREWS on (bolt — tighten before the counterpart threads on); pin = defines a joint whose counterpart DROPS on a preloaded pin (dowel/peg/barrel — tapped/pressed home, never spun); cam = defines a cam joint (tighten after both endpoints on).
